'''Erisi Dlarit's uncle''' was the brother of [[Aerin Dlarit]] and the uncle of [[Erisi Dlarit]]. He was a prominent investigator with the [[Xucphra Corporation]] [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] company on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], and discovered a contamination the [[Ashern]] rebels introduced into [[Lot ZX1449F]].
